about: #35's one committer (scope AC1, slice 4a): every repository write commits through the background coordinator, in the service worker, apart from the in-context writes listed here. test/kernel/one-committer.test.mjs reads this file against every root the build has: each page in scripts/build/vite-config.js's PAGES, by the scripts its HTML loads, and the worker from manifest.json, each through its static imports and every import() of a literal. A root #2 or #3 adds is checked with no edit to the test. `untilMoved` lists the pages that still commit in-process, each until the slice that moves its writes onto #13's port, and only shrinks. `inContext` lists what a page writes itself, or typing would wait on the worker. `reads` lists a module that writes, which a page loads only to read. `handles` lists a write through a handed-in handle, which no scan sees. `indexeddb` classifies every module under js/kernel/adapters/indexeddb/, so a new one can't land without a decision. #6's ntn.continuity, #16's appearance mirror, #1's product session (js/product/topology.js, which no root loads yet) and recovery.html's remediations under storage.restore (#20) join when they land.

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 slice 4b moves Popup's writes onto #13's port

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 slice 4c moves Side Panel's writes onto #13's port

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter, for the new tab and the PiP editor in its realm
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 slice 4d moves the new tab's and PiP's writes onto #13's port

inContext.writes: NewTabNoteJournal, through js/kernel/adapters/in-context.js: each page journals what it sends
NewTabNoteTrust, through js/kernel/adapters/in-context.js: the Trust Center's events, receipts and incidents
#20's chrome.storage.local keys: the sightings held while NewTabNoteTrust won't open
chrome.storage.local, through its settings handles: #11's and #19's holder settings and #17's session-state keys, with #17's adapter's settings until each page moves

reads.why: the new tab reads the pre-update copy for its export (legacy-export.js); its writes are the worker's migration run's (migrate.js)

handles.writes: #33's close-time drafts in localStorage, at pagehide
the removal of #33's close-time drafts, 1.4.3's catch-up key and the untold lists from localStorage, under DRAFTS_LOCK
#11's and #19's settings under setting_<key>, through js/kernel/composition/host.js

computedImports.loads: the vendored libraries under js/lib/, by URL (loadLibrary), which hold no repository write
